# Latina Dev

> Latina Dev is an open-source directory and community of Latina software engineers at the student, individual contributor (IC), and leadership levels. It exists to increase the visibility of Latina engineers and their access to opportunities across the tech industry.

Each member has a profile page at https://latina.dev/members/<slug> with their level and LinkedIn. Profiles may also include an affiliation, countries of heritage, and links to GitHub, X and a personal site, when the member has added them.

## Directory

- [Members](https://latina.dev/members): every member in the directory, with links to their profile pages
- [Members data feed](https://latina.dev/members.json): the same directory as JSON, built from the site's data files
- [About Latina Dev](https://latina.dev/#about): what the community is and who it is for
- [MCP server](https://latina.dev/mcp): a public, read-only Model Context Protocol server (Streamable HTTP, no auth) with tools to search members, to search resources by keyword, category, type, career stage and audience, to search Latinx employee resource groups by company, and to search career questions members answered. Setup: https://docs.latina.dev/#/pages/mcp-server
- [Add your profile](https://latina.dev/add-member): how a Latina software engineer can join the directory

## Resources

- [Resources and communities](https://latina.dev/resources): communities, AI communities and trainings, student programs, job boards, career and leadership groups, conferences, founder support, podcasts, newsletters and reports for Latina software engineers, grouped by career stage
- [Resources as Markdown](https://latina.dev/resources.md): every resource with its link, a one-line description, what it is, the career stage it helps most and who it is built for, in one file
- [Resources data feed](https://latina.dev/resources.json): the same list as JSON
- [Communities for Latinas in tech](https://latina.dev/resources/latina-communities)
- [Latino tech communities Latina engineers can join](https://latina.dev/resources/latino-tech-communities)
- [AI communities and programs for Latina software engineers](https://latina.dev/resources/ai)
- [Coding programs for Latina K-12 students](https://latina.dev/resources/k-12)
- [Programs and scholarships for Latina college students](https://latina.dev/resources/college)
- [Job boards for Latina engineers](https://latina.dev/resources/jobs)
- [Career growth and leadership for Latina engineers](https://latina.dev/resources/career-growth)
- [Conferences for Latinas in tech](https://latina.dev/resources/conferences)
- [Support for Latina founders](https://latina.dev/resources/founders)
- [Podcasts, newsletters and reports on Latinas in tech](https://latina.dev/resources/listen-and-read)
- [Resources for Latina college students in computer science](https://latina.dev/resources/stage/college)
- [Resources for Latina software engineers at work](https://latina.dev/resources/stage/workplace)
- [Resources for Latina engineering leaders](https://latina.dev/resources/stage/leadership)
- [Resources for Latina founders in tech](https://latina.dev/resources/stage/founders)
- [Communities for Latina software engineers to join](https://latina.dev/resources/type/community)
- [Coding programs, fellowships and cohorts for Latinas in tech](https://latina.dev/resources/type/program)
- [Scholarships for Latinas studying computer science](https://latina.dev/resources/type/scholarship)
- [Professional associations for Latina engineers](https://latina.dev/resources/type/professional-association)
- [Job boards that reach Latina software engineers](https://latina.dev/resources/type/job-board)
- [Conferences and summits for Latinas in tech](https://latina.dev/resources/type/conference)
- [Newsletters for Latina software engineers](https://latina.dev/resources/type/newsletter)
- [Latinx employee resource groups (ERGs) at companies](https://latina.dev/resources/ergs): companies with a group for Latina and Latino employees, the name each group goes by and a public source for each
- [ERGs as Markdown](https://latina.dev/ergs.md): the same list in one file
- [ERGs data feed](https://latina.dev/ergs.json): the same list as JSON
- [Should you lead an ERG? Make sure it counts toward your promotion](https://latina.dev/guides/erg-work-and-promotion): leading an ERG can be worth doing, but it is usually non-promotable work; what to know and ask for before saying yes, and how to make it count
- [Advice for Latina software engineers in the workplace](https://latina.dev/guides/workplace-advice): ask for what you want, write everything down, and weigh the cost of paying it forward
- [Helping Latina K-12 students get into coding](https://latina.dev/guides/k-12-students): why it matters and advice for parents and allies
- [Tips for recruiters hiring diverse software engineers](https://latina.dev/guides/hiring-diverse-engineers): how to reach and support Latina and other underrepresented engineers

## Community questions

- [Questions from Latina software engineers](https://latina.dev/questions): career questions members asked in the Latina Dev Slack, each with a page holding every answer and who gave it
- [Questions as Markdown](https://latina.dev/questions.md): every question and answer in one file
- [Questions data feed](https://latina.dev/questions.json): the same as JSON
- [Find support](https://latina.dev/find-support): pick where you are in your career and what you need, and get matching resources, guides, mentors and answered questions

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://docs.latina.dev): how the project works and how to contribute
- [Adding a member](https://docs.latina.dev/#/pages/adding-a-member): the member data format and how to add a profile
- [Members data feed](https://docs.latina.dev/#/pages/members-feed): the format of /members.json
- [MCP server](https://docs.latina.dev/#/pages/mcp-server): how to add latina.dev/mcp to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code
- [Member levels](https://docs.latina.dev/#/pages/member-levels): what Student, Individual Contributor and Leader mean
- [Contributing guide](https://github.com/Latina-Dev/latina-dev/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)
